title: QUADYX — Autonomous UAV Perception & Resilient Telemetry (Side Venture)

inspector.role: Streams synchronized camera frames and inertial telemetry into the onboard ROS 2 perception graph.
inspector.dataBoundary: Onboard edge compute boundary; zero cloud dependency for flight perception.
inspector.tradeoff: Monocular camera + IMU lowers payload weight and hardware cost compared to heavy solid-state LiDAR rigs.
inspector.failureBehavior: Dropped frame sequences trigger staleness watchdogs in the obstacle module.

inspector.role: Fuses visual-inertial SLAM pose tracking with monocular depth estimation for real-time 3D scene understanding.
inspector.dataBoundary: Local GPU/CPU inference pipeline with bounded frame latency.
inspector.tradeoff: Hybrid C++/Python split keeps high-frequency tracking deterministic in C++ while allowing rapid model iteration in Python.
inspector.failureBehavior: Tracking loss degrades gracefully to inertial hold while signaling the safety monitor.

inspector.role: Converts fused depth maps into spatial point-cloud clusters to flag obstacles along the planned flight corridor.
inspector.tradeoff: Geometric clustering stays explainable and fast on edge hardware compared to opaque end-to-end flight policies.
inspector.failureBehavior: Unclassified dense clusters expand safety margins automatically.

inspector.role: Continuously scores GSM and IP link health (RSSI, packet loss, heartbeat RTT) and switches transport channels automatically.
inspector.dataBoundary: Encrypted telemetry transport; sanitized operational metrics only.
inspector.tradeoff: Dual-channel GSM/IP switching adds state-machine complexity but avoids single-link blind spots in field conditions.
inspector.failureBehavior: If primary GSM link degrades or drops, traffic fails over to IP link; dual-loss triggers deterministic safe-hover/RTH behavior.

inspector.role: Delivers real-time health, perception alerts, and operator override controls to the ground control station.
inspector.dataBoundary: Authenticated operator channel with explicit human override priority.
inspector.tradeoff: ROS 2 standardized message contracts across perception, monitoring, and telemetry without custom binary framing.
inspector.failureBehavior: Operator retains immediate takeover authority; degraded links switch to compact heartbeat telemetry.

nominal.label: Nominal Flight Perception
nominal.description: Synchronized camera/IMU frames drive ORB-SLAM3 + Depth Anything V2, point-cloud obstacle detection, and live ROS 2 telemetry.

guardrail.label: Guardrail / GSM Signal Loss
guardrail.description: When primary GSM link degrades or perception confidence drops, the Python link monitor switches to IP fallback and triggers safe-state telemetry.
